summary: Iteration 2 full-stack verification of the dark-premium PT-KDRT rebuild. Backend: re-ran the existing pytest suite (10/10 pass: /api/health, /api/auth/client-ip incl. office/foreign IP rules, /api/scan-product + /api/scan-product-image success, data-url prefix, 400 on missing image, invalid base64). Frontend (Playwright on the preview URL, real Firebase project pt-kdrt, OWNER login): login page + wrong-password error + portal render verified, logo PNG decodes (naturalWidth=971) on login AND sidebar/portal marks, single 'Data Omset' sidebar entry with no separate 'Input Komisi Real' item, no 'Input Komisi Real' card on the OWNER portal, both Data Omset tabs with exactly the required fields, and the FULL CRITICAL DATA-PRESERVATION FLOW passed on the far-future date 2031-01-05 (GMV 5.000.000/300.000/12/45.000 -> Komisi Real 250.000 -> GMV values intact -> GMV re-save 6.000.000 -> Komisi Real still 250.000, exactly ONE doc PERFORMANCE_<accountId>_2031-01-05 in both tabs). Data Karyawan assigned-accounts checkbox group works. Sample 'size' free-text field saves, shows in the detail modal and re-opens in the edit form; an old sample without size opens fine (shows '-'). All 11 other modules render dark with no crash and no white/unreadable block except one KPI card. Found: 3 Firestore permission-denied collections, a mobile layout overflow on Data Omset, an unreadable Inventory KPI card, and an 'Input Komisi Real' card still present in the EMPLOYEE portal dashboard.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px the body grid child (form card + table card) is 680-738px wide and is clipped by the viewport (documentElement scrollWidth stays 390, element right edge = 738). The right half of the input form/table is unreachable on mobile. Cause: grid items default to min-width:auto, so the nowrap table's min-content width stretches the single mobile column. Fix: add `min-w-0` (and `overflow-hidden`) to both children of `div.mt-7.grid.gap-6.xl:grid-cols-[420px_1fr]` in PerformaHarianPage.tsx line ~446.

First KPI card uses a white/light gradient background while the label and value stay light blue/white -> text is practically unreadable (contrast failure). Only card on the page that was not migrated to the dark tokens.

'SAMPEL BARU (PROSES BERJALAN)' and 'KATALOG MASTER PRODUK AFFILIATE' header bars render on light tan / light lavender backgrounds with white text; the sub-caption under 'KATALOG MASTER PRODUK AFFILIATE' is unreadable.
Light-blue badge background with light-blue text -> low contrast.
ui_bugs.selector: Pengaturan & Audit > Sabtu (Jam Kerja Khusus) badge

ui_bugs.issue: For role EMPLOYEE the portal home still renders a separate 'Input Komisi Real' module card (EmployeePortalDashboard.tsx lines ~220-243, onNavigate('input-komisi-real')). It resolves to Data Omset tab 2 so it is not broken, but it contradicts the requirement that Input Komisi Real must not appear as its own module entry. Found by code review - no EMPLOYEE account exists to verify at runtime.
'Gaji Pokok Bulanan (Rp)' shows the raw value 2500000 instead of the formatted Rp 2.500.000 used everywhere else (helper text says 'Format: Rp 2.500.000').

integration_issues.issue: Firestore security rules deny reads for 3 collections for the OWNER user (uid fGko1Yd3kRPW6vQvSSYWlH5aM272): list `sampleLocations` (fires on Produk Sampel, Penataan Lokasi, Laporan), get `weeklyCommissions` and get `employeeCommissions` (fire on Input Manual Owner). Console shows 'permission-denied' + 'Uncaught Error in snapshot listener'. Visible effect: the 'Lokasi Rak / Hanger' select in the sample form is always empty and every sample shows 'Belum Ditata'. Needs Firestore rules update in project pt-kdrt (not a code fix).
permission-denied surfaces only as a console error; the UI silently shows empty state instead of an inline error/retry banner. Recommend surfacing handleFirestoreError to the user.

issues: Form/table column clipped horizontally (see ui_bugs HIGH item)
Leftover light-background blocks and badges with light text (contrast failures)

action_items: Add `min-w-0` to the two children of the Data Omset body grid (PerformaHarianPage.tsx ~line 446) so the form/table stop overflowing the 390px viewport.

Update Firestore security rules for `sampleLocations`, `weeklyCommissions` and `employeeCommissions` (OWNER currently gets permission-denied) and surface a user-visible error state when a listener is denied.
Restyle the 'TOTAL NILAI INVENTORY' KPI card, the Produk Sampel section header bands and the 'SETENGAH HARI' badge to the dark tokens (currently unreadable light-on-light).
Remove the 'Input Komisi Real' module card from EmployeePortalDashboard (or relabel it 'Data Omset') to satisfy the merge requirement for EMPLOYEE users.
Format the 'Gaji Pokok Bulanan' input with the Rupiah mask used elsewhere.
critical_code_review_comments: File size: DatabaseSampelPage.tsx (~2200 lines), KaryawanPage.tsx (~1500 lines) and PerformaHarianPage.tsx (777 lines) exceed the 700-line guideline - split forms/modals/tables into sub-components.

saveOmsetData/saveKomisiReal correctly read the existing doc and carry the other tab's fields forward, but they are not transactional (getDoc then setDoc) - two concurrent saves on the same accountId+date could still clobber a field. Consider runTransaction for both.
saveKomisiReal spreads the whole `entry` into perfData (`...entry`), so any extra caller-supplied key is persisted unvalidated; whitelist the fields as saveOmsetData does.

PerformaHarianPage.visiblePerformances falls back to matching by accountName for EMPLOYEE; with two distinct accounts sharing the name 'POV Kokamseng' in production this leaks/duplicates rows. Prefer accountId-only matching.
Firestore listener errors are logged only (handleFirestoreError -> console); add UI error state so silent empty lists are not mistaken for 'no data'.

Portal module cards and the Karyawan add button had no data-testid - added during this run; keep adding data-testid to all interactive elements (Produk Sampel Detail/Edit/Delete buttons and the sample form still have none, so tests must use text/DOM traversal).
seed_data_creation: Created dailyPerformance doc PERFORMANCE_CKy4e96NOkde6L5z3I9m_2031-01-05 (POV Kokamseng, GMV 6.000.000, est 300.000, itemSold 12, impression 45.000, commissionReal 250.000) + its deterministic COMMISSION_REAL transaction - intentionally left in place as the proof of the preservation flow on a far-future date; delete via the Data Omset delete action if unwanted. One temporary affiliateSample record was created (auto-expense/auto-task unchecked) to validate the size field and was DELETED afterwards - sample count is back to the original 1. No existing production document was modified or deleted.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is stable (10/10) at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py - just re-run pytest. Frontend has no REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env (Vite app, VITE_* keys only); use the preview URL directly. Test doc id PERFORMANCE_CKy4e96NOkde6L5z3I9m_2031-01-05 already exists - reuse another far-future date (e.g. 2031-02-xx) for fresh preservation tests. Produk Sampel/Karyawan modals expose only a few data-testids; the sample form opens exclusively via the '+ BELI SAMPEL' button on the KATALOG MASTER PRODUK tab or the pencil icon on a sample card (tab buttons must be clicked via DOM traversal on button innerText). Pages need ~5-6s after navigation before Firestore snapshots populate. Known open items: mobile overflow on Data Omset, 3 permission-denied Firestore collections, light-on-light Inventory KPI card.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Mobile overflow: the Data Omset body uses `grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[420px_1fr]`; grid items keep min-width:auto, so the nowrap recap table's min-content width (~720px) stretches the single mobile column past the 390px viewport while the ancestor clips it -> add min-w-0. 2) permission-denied: Firestore rules in project pt-kdrt have no read rule for sampleLocations/weeklyCommissions/employeeCommissions; the client code is correct, only the rules must be published. 3) Data preservation works because both writers read the existing doc first and re-write the other tab's fields with a deterministic doc id PERFORMANCE_<accountId>_<date>, which also guarantees the single-record upsert (verified: one row in both tabs after 3 saves).
